headline: Egypt Reports $852 Million in Medicinal and Aromatic Plant Exports for 2025
summary: Egypt's exports of medicinal and aromatic plants and related products reached approximately $852 million in 2025, according to Agriculture Minister Alaa Farouk.
why: Agricultural export revenues contribute to the country's foreign exchange earnings and trade balance within specific commodity sectors.

impacts.why: Export performance reflects economic output in the agricultural and processing sectors.
